summary: Complete CRM integration testing for LUIGGI HOME. All 8 requested features verified and working correctly. Backend: 16/16 CRM tests passed. Frontend: All CRM UI flows working.
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRM integration fully working. APIs: /api/crm/contacts, /api/crm/opportunities, /api/crm/activities, /api/crm/dashboard. Navigation buttons in sidebar: CRM, Pipeline, Contactos. All CRUD operations verified.

login_mario.details: Login with MARIO/MARIO credentials works correctly. User is admin with full permissions.

navigation_crm_buttons.details: Sidebar shows new CRM buttons: CRM (Dashboard), Pipeline, Contactos. All buttons clickable and navigate correctly.

crm_dashboard_metrics.details: CRM Dashboard shows metrics: TOTAL CONTACTOS, OPORTUNIDADES ACTIVAS, GANADAS ESTE MES, INGRESOS PIPELINE. Also shows TOP OPORTUNIDADES, PRÓXIMAS ACTIVIDADES, ACTIVIDAD RECIENTE sections.

crm_pipeline_stages.details: Pipeline shows 5 stages: NUEVO LEAD, CONTACTADO, PROPUESTA, NEGOCIACIÓN, GANADA. Each stage shows count and value. Kanban-style layout.

create_opportunity_from_pipeline.details: Nueva Oportunidad button opens modal with fields: TÍTULO, CONTACTO, ETAPA, VALOR, PROBABILIDAD, FECHA CIERRE, DESCRIPCIÓN, NOTAS. Opportunity created successfully and appears in pipeline.

crm_contacts_crud.details: Contacts page allows create, edit, delete contacts. Modal has fields: NOMBRE, EMPRESA, EMAIL, TELÉFONO, CARGO, ESTADO, DIRECCIÓN, NOTAS. Status filter and search work.

create_contact_verify_list.details: Created contact 'TEST_Juan García Prueba' with company, email, phone. Contact appeared in list with correct data and Lead status.

api_endpoints_crm.details: All CRM API endpoints working: GET/POST /api/crm/contacts, GET/POST /api/crm/opportunities, GET/POST /api/crm/activities, GET /api/crm/dashboard
